title: Harrington denies Brent Friedman's account
place_text: Walnut Creek, California and Washington DC

tellings.quote: lower level. Uh so that's all a lie. And then I told him that I'd been locked away for a month and I'd seen people from another planet. It's just total BS.

related.note: Harrington himself tells about the same claimed 1981 conversation and denies it: he says he never said he saw aliens or was locked away.

plain: John S. Herrington, a former US Secretary of Energy, flatly denies a story the Hollywood screenwriter Brent Friedman tells about him from around 1981, set between Walnut Creek, California and Washington. Herrington says on the podcast that the claim he told Friedman he had "been locked away for a month" and had "seen people from another planet" is "all a lie" and "total BS." This matters because Friedman's version would have a former cabinet member admitting to seeing aliens, and Herrington himself says it never happened.
